app.name: Shakti Prime
app.tagline: One place to run Shakti's leads, sales, stock, projects and payments.

errors.validation_failed: Some details are missing or incorrect. Please check and try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have access to this. Ask your manager if you need it.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find this. It may have been removed.
errors.conflict: This changed while you were working on it. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts in a short time. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.integration_unavailable: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a minute.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a minute.
errors.lead_pipeline_missing: This pipeline is not set up yet. Ask an Executive to add it.
errors.lead_source_unknown: This lead source is not in the list. Choose one from the list.
errors.phone_invalid: Please check the phone number. Enter the 10-digit mobile number.
errors.price_list_missing: This price list is not available. Choose another list or ask an Executive.
errors.price_list_closed: This price list has ended and can no longer be changed. Start a new price list instead.
errors.price_item_missing: This item is not active, so it cannot be priced. Check the item list.
errors.sign_in_failed: We couldn't sign you in with that email and password. Please check both and try again.
errors.password_incorrect: That password is not right. Please try again.
errors.password_too_short: Your password needs at least 12 characters. A short sentence works well.
errors.password_too_long: Your password is too long. Keep it under 128 characters.
errors.password_breached: This password has appeared in a known leak, so it isn't safe. Please choose a different one.
errors.password_mismatch: The two passwords don't match. Please type them again.
errors.link_expired: This link has expired or was already used. Ask your manager to send a new one.
errors.code_incorrect: That code didn't work. Open your authenticator app and enter the latest code.
errors.authenticator_already_set: Your authenticator app is already set up. Sign in with a code from it.
errors.authenticator_missing: Your authenticator app is not set up yet. Set it up first.
errors.account_locked: Too many attempts. Please wait a while before trying again.
errors.bot_check_failed: We couldn't confirm you're a person. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.totp_required: Your role needs an authenticator app. Set it up to continue.
errors.entity_outside_scope: You can only give access to companies you manage.
errors.invite_email_taken: Someone already has this email. Check the team list.
errors.role_missing: This role is not available. Choose one from the list.
errors.team_missing: This team belongs to another company. Choose a team from the same company.
errors.user_missing: We couldn't find this team member. The list may have changed.
errors.user_offboarded: This person has left. Invite them again to give access.
errors.self_suspend: You can't suspend your own access. Ask another Executive.
errors.account_missing: We couldn't find this customer. Search again or create a new customer.
errors.self_role_change: You can't change your own roles. Ask another Executive.
errors.user_roles_outside_scope: This person also works in a company you are not viewing. Switch to all companies and try again.
errors.no_access: Your account has no access at the moment. Ask your manager.
errors.backup_code_incorrect: That backup code didn't work. Check it and try again, or use a code from your app.
errors.code_attempts_exhausted: Too many wrong codes. Sign in again and try with a fresh code.
errors.code_session_expired: This sign-in took too long. Please sign in again.
errors.request_refused: We couldn't do that just now. Refresh the page and try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use the email and password your manager set up for you.

setPassword.title: Choose your password
setPassword.intro: This password is yours alone. Use at least 12 characters; a short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
setPassword.done: Your password is saved. You can sign in now.

twoFactor.enrolIntro: Your role needs a second check at sign-in. Install an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator on your phone, then confirm your password to begin.
twoFactor.scanTitle: Scan this with your authenticator app
twoFactor.scanIntro: Open the app, choose “Add account” and scan the square. If the camera doesn't work, type the key below by hand.
twoFactor.backupIntro: Each code works once, if your phone is ever lost. Write them down or save them somewhere private.
twoFactor.verifyTitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app
twoFactor.verifyIntro: Open the app on your phone and type the 6-digit code shown for Shakti Prime.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.done: Your password is changed. Other devices are signed out.

setPassword.subject: Your Shakti Prime sign-in
setPassword.body:
Hello {name},

Your Shakti Prime access is ready. Open this link to choose your password:
{url}

The link works for one day. If you didn't expect this email, you can ignore it.

Shakti Prime
